title: Samarthya 2026 National Project Competition
description: Present an innovative technical project on Women Empowerment or Open Innovation in a national competition and compete for INR 10,000 in cash prizes. Open to students from any recognised college.
descriptionDetailed: Samarthya 2026, organised by the SKN IEEE Student Branch, is a national-level hybrid project competition across three rounds: a project proposal presentation, a prototype video, and a final jury presentation. Projects address either Women Empowerment (technology-based solutions to women-centric social challenges) or Open Innovation (practical problems from any domain). Cash prizes total INR 10,000 with a dedicated Best Women-Centric Project award, plus certificates and national recognition.

prize.description: Winner receives INR 5,000, first runner-up INR 2,500, second runner-up INR 1,500, and the Best Women-Centric Project receives INR 1,000. Participants also receive participation or merit certificates and national recognition.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to students from any college
audience.eligibilityDetail: Teams of one to four students from any recognised college may participate, including inter-college teams. Each team selects either the Women Empowerment or Open Innovation theme.
